rule: A late customer.subscription.updated must not recreate a subscription that customer.subscription.deleted removed
setup: INSERT INTO subscription(id,customer_id,active) VALUES ('sub_1','cus_1',true); INSERT INTO stripe_truth VALUES ('sub_1','canceled')
invariant: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscription WHERE src='late_updated')
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: SELECT set_config('app.f1',(SELECT count(*)::text FROM subscription WHERE id='sub_1'),false)
UPDATE subscription SET active=true WHERE id='sub_1' AND current_setting('app.f1')='1'

INSERT INTO subscription(id,customer_id,active,src) SELECT 'sub_1','cus_1',true,'late_updated' WHERE current_setting('app.f1')='0' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stripe_truth WHERE id='sub_1' AND status IN ('canceled','incomplete_expired'))
